title: Hardware Procurement Late Fees and the Professional Services Projects Deposit
content:
On a Professional Services Projects time-and-materials statement of work, late fees on the client's Hardware Procurement billing raise the deposit percentage.

For a client whose Hardware Procurement billing shows two or more late fees posted in the twelve months before signature, 10.0 percentage points are added to the deposit percentage, 5.0 points for exactly one such late fee, and none for a client with no such late fee.

A late fee counts toward the twelve-month window when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posted date from the signature date, which is the day the deposit is invoiced, a whole month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.

| Hardware Procurement late fees posted in the twelve months | Points added to the deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| two or more | 10.0 |
| exactly one | 5.0 |
| none | none |

Only late fees on the Hardware Procurement billing count; payments, invoices and credits on that billing do not.

Hypothetical illustration: a client with three Hardware Procurement late fees, of which one was posted fourteen months before the signature date and two within the last six months, has two late fees in the window and carries 10.0 additional points.
